message.content:
This is a tanker trailer designed to be towed, so heading 8716 is the likely fit. Within 8716, subheading 8716.31 covers tanker trailers and semi-trailers, and 8716.31.00 splits into statistical suffixes.

I recall CBP rulings on propane tanker trailers, though I am not certain of the exact ruling number. The ruling likely classified them in 8716.31.0050, "Tanker trailers and tanker semitrailers: Other." The alternative, 8716.31.0010, is for agricultural trailers, and I believe the 8716.31 split is 0010 for "Trailers... for agricultural use" and 0050 for "Other."

The alternative considered was heading 8609 (containers) or 7311 (compressed gas containers). But the trailer is a vehicle with a tow bar, wheels, and a coupler, so 8716 governs.

On the statistical suffix, I recall 8716.31.0000 being divided into 0010 "Tanker trailers and tanker semitrailers" with a further breakdown. The 2022 HTSUS has 8716.31.00: 8716.31.0010 for "Trailers and semitrailers of the type used for agricultural purposes" and 8716.31.0050 for "Other." I'll go with 8716.31.0050.
